# Wazuh Manage

## Overview

gSage AI — Wazuh operational response tool (requires human approval).

## Tool

| Tool | Summary | Permissions | Requires approval | Core |
| --- | --- | --- | :---: | :---: |
| `wazuh_manage` | Wazuh response actions (active-response, restart agent, group membership) — requires human approval | `wazuh:write` | ✓ | — |

## Configuration

> The JSON below goes into the **configtool model** in the web UI (per organisation; can also be scoped to a department).

> **Multiple profiles supported** — you may create more than one config row per organisation, each with a distinct `profile_id`. The agent picks one via the `config_profile` parameter at call time. State, rate limits and circuit-breaker counters are isolated per profile.

> **Sensitive fields** (api keys / passwords / tokens) are *omitted* from the JSON below — set them via environment variables (see the _Environment variables_ table) or directly in the encrypted DB row from the web UI.

### Empty configtool template (required fields only)

```json
{
  "url": "<value>",
  "username": "<value>",
  "password": "<value>"
}
```

### Example configtool model

```json
{
  "password": "<value>",
  "timeout": 30,
  "url": "<value>",
  "username": "<value>",
  "verify_tls": true
}
```

### Field reference

| Field | Type | Required | Sensitive | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | :---: | :---: | --- | --- |
| `password` | `string` | ✓ | ✓ | — | Wazuh API password. |
| `timeout` | `integer` | — | — | `30` | HTTP request timeout in seconds (default: 30). |
| `url` | `string` | ✓ | — | — | Wazuh Manager API base URL including port, e.g. https://wazuh.example.com:55000. Must be reachable from the mcp-server container. |
| `username` | `string` | ✓ | — | — | Wazuh API user (e.g. 'wazuh' or 'wazuh-wui'). |
| `verify_tls` | `boolean` | — | — | `true` | Verify the server TLS certificate (default: true). Wazuh ships a self-signed certificate by default, so set this to false for out-of-the-box deployments. |

| `TOOL_WAZUH_MANAGE__URL` | `url` | `string` | — | — | Wazuh Manager API base URL including port, e.g. https://wazuh.example.com:55000. Must be reachable from the mcp-server container. |
| `TOOL_WAZUH_MANAGE__USERNAME` | `username` | `string` | — | — | Wazuh API user (e.g. 'wazuh' or 'wazuh-wui'). |
| `TOOL_WAZUH_MANAGE__VERIFY_TLS` | `verify_tls` | `boolean` | `true` | — | Verify the server TLS certificate (default: true). Wazuh ships a self-signed certificate by default, so set this to false for out-of-the-box deployments. |
| `TOOL_WAZUH_MANAGE__AUTO_APPROVE` | `auto_approve` | `boolean` | `false` | — | When true, HITL approval requests for this tool are auto-approved by the backend without human review. Useful for lab/dev environments. DB toolconfig overrides env TOOL_<NAME>__AUTO_APPROVE; default is false. |

## Operations

### `wazuh_manage`

- **`active_response`** — _(no description)_

  | Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
  | --- | --- | :---: | --- |
  | `agent_id` | `string` | — | Target agent ID (e.g. '001'). Required for restart_agent, add_to_group, remove_from_group, and for active_response unless 'all_agents' is true. |
  | `all_agents` | `boolean` | — | For active_response: apply to all agents instead of one. |
  | `command` | `string` | — | Active-response command name as configured on the manager (e.g. 'firewall-drop', 'host-deny', 'restart-wazuh'). Required for active_response. A leading '!' is added automatically if omitted. |
